assessments.reasoning: Four contiguous captures cover all 60,636 bytes of spdx/license-list-data/json/details/CC-BY-NC-SA-2.0-DE.json at 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, SHA-256 8b828e48678c361cb88dc08ec1047b67222389e1d3acda45de9d2a83551743f3. The record gives licenseId CC-BY-NC-SA-2.0-DE, name “Creative Commons Attribution Non Commercial Share Alike 2.0 Germany” and isDeprecatedLicenseId false. Its German licenseText opens with the publisher title prefixed by “Creative Commons”, includes the three §1(b) elements and contains §8(f). The exact cited URL appears in both crossRef and seeAlso. The generated template and HTML share this record’s provenance.

The GitHub API response for tag object 76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b in spdx/license-list-data names v3.29.0 and gives object.type = commit and object.sha = 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48. This matches the generated file’s revision. The response explicitly reports an unsigned tag, so the evidence establishes the repository’s recorded target without signer verification.

The original Creative Commons response at the exact cited /legalcode URL has the claim’s measured SHA-256 d88be489f05079a292baa8faf4bdf81153c2748198da6d4a654428993749cea4. Its German main heading reads “Namensnennung — Nicht-kommerziell — Weitergabe unter gleichen Bedingungen 2.0” and its adjacent identifier reads “CC BY-NC-SA 2.0 DE”. These fields identify the destination of the SPDX citation. SPDX itself supplies the list membership evidence.

Direct inspection across parts 2 and 3 of the publisher HTML gives the complete §8(f) sentence “Auf diesen Lizenzvertrag findet das Recht der Bundesrepublik Deutschland Anwendung.” The pinned SPDX licenseText reproduces that sentence at §8(f). This supports the German documentary context even though the displayed 2.0 title omits “Deutschland”. Repetition in the generated record supplies no independent legal authority.

limitations: The finding covers one generated detail at one release and one measured publisher HTML response. It establishes neither semantic or translation equivalence nor the license of any downstream file or project. Interpretation, applicable grants and redistribution rights remain outside scope.

The SPDX citation ends in /legalcode. The publisher’s HTML canonical link ends in /legalcode.de. Their byte and legal equivalence remain unestablished, and the measured HTML digest does not guarantee future content.

The SPDX deprecation flag describes this identifier in 3.29.0. The Index’s active value describes editorial maintenance alone. Publisher currency, legal effect and Index publication lie outside both fields.
This research finding requires separate independent review before qualification. Revalidation is due 2027-05-25T00:00:00Z, or earlier upon a relevant correction or contrary evidence.
